subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Lloyd's Coffee House: Insuring the World
description: A short lesson to help you apply Lloyd's Coffee House: Insuring the World.

hook.text: Lloyd's of London—the world's most famous insurance market—started as a coffee shop in 1688.

buildup.text: Edward Lloyd's coffeehouse near the Thames became a meeting point for ship owners, captains, and merchants.

discovery.text: Merchants began writing informal insurance policies in the shop—betting on whether ships would arrive safely.

twist.text: These informal deals evolved into the most powerful insurance market on Earth, still operating under Lloyd's name today.

climax.text: From sipping coffee to insuring satellites and oil rigs—all starting from conversations between table and cup.

punchline.text: A coffeehouse became a global insurance giant. Conversations have consequences.

quiz.question: What institution grew out of Edward Lloyd's coffeehouse?
